## Topics

Course 2 of 3 in the [Machine Learning Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/machine-learning-introduction) by Andrew Ng (DeepLearning.AI / Stanford).

You finished [Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification](/machine-learning/supervised-machine-learning/index.qmd) in Course 1. This track picks up with **neural networks** (also called **deep learning**), then **practical system-building advice**, and finally **decision trees**.

### Notes

These pages follow the Coursera videos and labs, rewritten for high school readers with review questions and plots where they help.
